translations.web: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
translations.bsb: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is attained along the path of righteousness.
translations.kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
translations.asv: The hoary head is a crown of glory; It shall be found in the way of righteousness.
